$comment: Pack Rat profiles.json schema v2. Draft-07 style, restricted to the keyword subset app/schema/validate.mjs supports (see that file's header) — that validator has no keyword for applying a subschema to every value of an arbitrarily-keyed object (only fixed `properties`), so `characters` and `templates` are checked for shape (must be objects) but their per-character/per-template contents are not walked field-by-field here, the same tradeoff scan.v2.schema.json makes for `containers`. A character entry is loosely {template?, floors?, softFloors?, weights?, floorBonus?, lockedSlots?, excludeTags?, excludeSkills?, allowOthersWorn?, allowGargoyle?, medOnly?, weaponSkill?, race?, strLimit?, caps?} (see app/vault-lib.mts and CONTRIBUTING.md's Templates section); a template entry is the same minus race/strLimit. additionalProperties is true throughout (a `_comment` key, and any field a newer client adds, must round-trip through PUT /api/profiles unharmed).
